findings.title: Read current explicit finalFocus when a retained popup unmounts
findings.body: onOpenChange caches the entire returnFocus value and cleanup reads that captured value at870. With preventUnmountOnClose, replacing explicit finalFocus callback/ref/boolean while closed leaves a mounted exit subtree. Original useValueAsRef reads the replacement at cleanup; native invokes the old callback/target. The paired public Root/Popup probe produces Original new/new-target and native old/old-target. Preserve the native mounted default decision separately while retaining latest explicit owner prop; do not freeze the generic FFM prop or introduce a React snapshot engine.

findings.title: Use the destination store shared hover instance after a handle handoff
findings.body: The effect fills only empty destination dataRef.hoverInteractionState, but the return remains the initial instance. Original returns the current store existing instance. createMenuTrigger follows reactive handle.store/floatingRootContext, so changing its public handle to another already-mounted open Root gives reference/floating helpers different hover state. Paired actual helper migration and public two-handle handoff probes pass Original and fail native; touch pointer modality stays undefined in the destination popup. Resolve shared state from current root and make helper callers read that current instance, preserving initial disposal and destination ownership.
